description: This file contains implementation code for inlining forked closures in the PyTorch JIT compiler, including functions to inline closure nodes, handle subgraphs, and traverse graph blocks.

methods.name: inlineForkedClosure
methods.description: Inlines a forked closure node by replacing it with its subgraph and adjusting inputs and outputs.

methods.name: inlineForkedClosures
methods.description: Recursively traverses a graph block to inline all forked closure nodes.
